description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Column' which extends 'DynamicComponent'. It provides a flexible, styled column layout with configurable alignment and distribution, including styles, template, and inputs.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: An Angular component implementing a flexible column layout with customizable styles and properties.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property to set the alignment of the column (default: 'stretch').

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property to set the distribution of content within the column (default: 'start').

methods.name: classes
methods.description: Computed property that returns the class mappings based on theme, alignment, and distribution.
